base_member_text: [L19-L22] (LOW/path-contract) The script constructs the working directory as %SolutionDir%scripts without inserting a separator and invokes dist\generate.exe without checking either cd or executable success, making correctness depend on an undocumented trailing separator and silent failure possible.
audit_member_text: [L21-L23] (MED/error-propagation) Neither the directory change nor generator execution is checked, and the final cd can hide generator failure from the caller.
[L21] (LOW/path-quoting) The scripts-directory cd command has an opening quote without a closing quote, relying on permissive command parsing.
[L4-L11,L19,L23] (LOW/environment-leakage) The script changes generic caller environment variables without SETLOCAL, leaving build-script state in the invoking shell.
